title: TPG Telecom Limited - proposed acquisition of iiNet Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from the merger parties.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed decision date of 4 June 2015 delayed to give the merger parties more time to respond to the ACCC's information request.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC requested further information from the merger parties.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: TPG Telecom Limited proposed to acquire iiNet Limited.
